PREPARE_DESC: Copy your music folders into the input folder /mnt/HDD/in/music. Every nested folder is processed on its own, the structure does not matter (artist, album, compilation — anything). The input folder is cleaned after processing.
RESULT_DESC: Finished tracks are sorted by tags into /mnt/HDD/out/music: artist / album.
RUN_DESC: Press the button to open the preparation window: start button, current step and live log.
TOAST_EMPTY: No audio files in the input folder
TOAST_ERROR: Processing failed. See the plugin log.
TOAST_NO_DISK: /mnt/HDD is not available. Connect and mount the disk first.
TOAST_CANCELLED: Stopped. Finished albums are already in the output folder.
RG_ERROR: Could not apply the MPD configuration. See the plugin log.
REPLAYGAIN_DESC: Volumio has no ReplayGain option of its own, so MPD ignores the ReplayGain tags this plugin writes and web radio plays louder than your library. Switch this on and the plugin asks Volumio's MPD plugin to add volume leveling to its configuration — nothing is edited by hand and no root access is needed: MPD applies the measured gain to tagged tracks and -8 dB to streams and files without tags. MPD restarts once, so playback stops for a few seconds. If Volumio's own volume normalization is enabled in Playback Options, switch it off: it would correct the volume a second time on top of ReplayGain.
RG_DOC: Track gain measured at -18 LUFS is written into the files during preparation. Turning this off removes the lines from the MPD configuration again; the tags stay in the files.
